title: Synchronous extent miss must release E while retaining exact read custody
detail: REAL. fn-durable-realize-octet/span/octets hold E through fnn-extent-entry, whose miss calls fnn-extent-entry-direct then fnn-extent-read-verified / fnn-extent-read-entry / pread. E protects descriptors, cache and resource leases, so every cache hit and cold worker settlement waits behind a stalled disk. Served chunk spans bind *fnn-extent-no-io* and throw before this path, but the direct funded/offline fallback exists and BP can reach it with O held.
fix: PROP specified; implementation remains open. Introduce a synchronous activation holder, joined to exact descriptor and buffer custody, before splitting capture/physical-read/settle. Do not reuse a persistent executor row or drop E around the current activation. O-held callers also require a cold-read continuation.
notes: Statement first, lock-r2-class, 2026-10-08; traced checkout 414aed260. No numbered identifier required for descriptive LOCK repair IDs.
The cited fnn-owner-held-commit host macro is absent from this checkout; lane-commit-held-host contains an implementation to inspect as an integration dependency.

No extent edits made; E:fnn-extent-pread remains. fn-owner-page-read-direct-mode explicitly permits :funded-pool when :served with installed data, as well as offline, so the synchronous fallback cannot be dismissed as always offline.

An off-E read must retain the exact descriptor until physical return, preserve the funded discovery/read lease and keep the final cache borrow protected. fnn-extent-close checks fn-pio-direct-quiet-p for direct holds and fn-owner-page-read-close-preview for funded holds. Dropping E around pread without those joins permits retirement to close the captured fd.
Natives for C after the custody split: tests.test_native_page_io, tests.test_native_cold_off_loop, tests.test_native_slow_disk.

Round 2 scope investigation: no safe implementation confined to extent.lisp and page-read-host.lisp was found. The funded sync row is activation-local (fn-pio-own-admitted-token), while the offline sync path has no global file hold. Existing fn-pio-direct-admit/settle joins a physical executor row, issued-read roster and file-hold table; pretending a synchronous activation is that executor violates its holder relation. A new synchronous holder/phase must be modeled in the page-read ownership/direct books and their holder declarations before releasing E. O-held callers additionally need the owning lane continuation. No extent/page-read host edit is made; E:pread remains REAL.

lock-classes, 2026-10-08, HEAD 530f44d08: extent.lisp:1420-1466 still has both offline and funded synchronous arms; page-read-host.lisp:42 permits the funded arm in served mode. The row at extent.lisp:1448 is local to the activation, not entered in *fnn-extent-issued*. page-read-direct.lisp:234 settles only a matching physical worker already :returned. Its def-holder at :334 has no synchronous activation holder. Existing worker custody therefore does not justify unlocking the synchronous path.

PROP (statement first, not an admitted theorem): Let I(S) join descriptor incarnations D, synchronous activations A, issued rows R, identified file holds H, funded ledger L, cache bindings C and active vector borrows B. For every live activation a, its fresh token t=(id,cid,file,eoff,elen,trailer) names exactly one immutable descriptor incarnation d=D[file] and one private output buffer b; the file hold (file,t) is in H and, in funded mode, L owns the exact read/buffer/execution charge before b is allocated. A records physical phase captured/running/returned, publication permission, the exact buffer identity and transfer status. Offline mode still requires the file hold and physical phase, but never fabricates a funded lease or a persistent executor.

PROP preservation: For every capture, begin-read, cancellation, retirement request, actual physical return, verification, cache transfer, borrow and borrow-return step permitted by the new synchronous step, I(S) implies I(S2). Capture and settlement hold E; physical pread holds neither E nor O. Until the matching actual-return receipt, cancellation only revokes publication: D[file]=d, (file,t) remains in H, b is privately owned and no charge is refunded. Retirement cannot authorize close/rebind of d during this interval. A stale or duplicate return cannot publish, drop any hold, or refund any lease.

PROP publication: publish(t,b) implies exact matching actual return, complete byte count for the captured span, fn-arx-entry-verdict-buffer=:ok for the captured trailer, and publication permission not revoked. Transfer moves b and its charge exactly once to either the verified cache or an explicit caller borrow. Failed or cancelled reads release only after the physical call and verifier aliases have unwound. An ambiguous cache transfer retains charge. Cache eviction cannot refund while B contains a borrow of b; the octet/span/octets consumer keeps the borrow through its last copied byte. After the last borrow and exact settlement, the descriptor/read holders can each be released once.

PROP refinement: Under A-DURABLE-EXTENT and the same registered descriptor and observation sequence, removing capture/return/lock labels yields the current synchronous realizer result and fault class, plus the same final cache/resource effects. A successful capture witness must instantiate every I premise, return the full committed entry and consume a final borrow. Wrong-answer witnesses must independently remove the file hold, substitute a reused fd/incarnation or token, cancel before return, deliver a stale/duplicate return, refund while a borrow survives, and publish after failed verification. None is claimed proved here.

Concrete missing-premise trace: offline synchronous capture reads d=gethash(file,*fnn-extent-fds*); dropping E now allows fnn-extent-close to see fn-pio-direct-quiet-p=true and close-preview=:unfunded-offline, close d and remove the mapping before pread(d,b,eoff). Reuse of the OS descriptor can then read another file. In funded mode the ledger can pin the file, but the activation and its final cache borrow still have no joined interleaving theorem. This is why a simple unlock/relock is rejected; no host edit is made.

Disposition: use the task-authorized PROP-and-stop option for this class. E:fnn-extent-pread remains REAL; no keys removed, no certification claimed. C natives remain tests.test_native_page_io, tests.test_native_cold_off_loop, tests.test_native_slow_disk, with a future stalled-read/cancel/retire/cache-evict fixture testing the synchronous holder.

Final retained-tree lock comparison against 530f44d08: 234 keys have identical per-key site counts; 0 keys removed, 0 added, 0 counts rising, 0 NEW outside coordinator lock-dev-keys.txt (including its explicit ENCLAVE row). Full lock gate remains red: 52 new keys, 15 stale. Report: build/lock-classes/lock-comparison.json; printed counts: build/lock-classes/site-counts.txt. This class is not READY.
